title: Raspberry Pi 5 page size issues (ARM - 16K page size)
body:
## Description

Raspbian OS 64bit now brings 16K page size by default for the new Raspberry Pi 5, causing jemalloc unsupported system page size.
Similar issue on ARM machines: #969 

## Steps to reproduce

Run any typesense docker image:

```
export TYPESENSE_API_KEY=xyz

mkdir $(pwd)/typesense-data

docker run -p 8108:8108 -v$(pwd)/typesense-data:/data typesense/typesense:0.25.1 \
  --data-dir /data --api-key=$TYPESENSE_API_KEY --enable-cors
```

## Expected Behavior

Container running successfully.

## Actual Behavior

```
<jemalloc>: Unsupported system page size
<jemalloc>: Unsupported system page size
<jemalloc>: Unsupported system page size
...
<jemalloc>: Unsupported system page size
<jemalloc>: Unsupported system page size
terminate called without an active exception
```

## Metadata

**Typesense Version**: 0.24.1, 0.25.1, 0.26.0

**OS**: Raspbian OS 64bit

comments.author: reporter
comments.body:
What you get on the build is the actual executable, not a docker image, so what I did was:

`tar -xvf typesense-server-0.26.0.rcjemalloc1-linux-arm64.tar.gz`

You will now have the typesense-server executable. From here I built an image containing this executable. Here's the Dockerfile:
```
FROM typesense/typesense:0.26.0.rc38-arm64
COPY typesense-server /opt
ENTRYPOINT ["/opt/typesense-server"]
```
Just build this with `docker build` on the same directory you unpacked the executable and replace on the docker-compose files the typesense image with the custom one you just build.

Hope this helps.

comments.author: reporter
comments.body:
When building a local docker image you can specify any tag:
`docker build . -t custom/image_name`
Then change it on your docker compose file:
```diff
typesense:
    container_name: typesense
-   image: typesense/typesense
+   image: custom/image_name
    environment:
```

comments.body: As of v28.0, we had to revert back the default pg size in the main ARM build to 4K. But we now publish a separate lg-pg-size build that has the page size set to 16K: https://typesense.org/docs/guide/install-typesense.html#large-page-size-build
